messages.text: I fill out a form RMA last week when my miner decided to throw sparks

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this over to me.

Sparks mean a short, so first things first:

1. Leave it unplugged, at the wall, and do not plug it back in to test it.
2. Keep it off any carpet or flammable surface until we have it sorted.
3. If you can, take a photo of the board where the sparks came from and a clear photo of the serial number label. That helps the team place it fast.

A unit that sparked is a board-level fault, not something to fix with settings or a new power brick, so I'm not going to have you power it up again. I'm passing my findings on it to the team now, along with the note that you already filled in the RMA form last week.
Handed to the team · Safety: customer reports sparks from a NerdQaxe++ 6 TH. Board-level short, unit
Sarah is picking this back up with my findings.
